description: Usines hydroélectriques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Hydraulic structure dedicated to the production of electricity. The main categories are lake mills, lock mills, run-of-water mills, and pumped power transfer plants. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydroelectric plants" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include France, Hydromorphologie, Hydroeléctricité, Centrale, Ouvrage, Force motrice. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
